from_note: Detail: High-beam out splice - SP-HR-HI: K-HR 87 to both high beams and the dash high-beam LED (Dan A2 b); glove box, beside the LOGIC box; Fed by: LOGIC HR 15 A fuse -> high-beam relay K-HR
to_desc: high beam LED pigtail (20 AWG), spliced
to_note: Detail: high-beam LED + on the cluster LED board (centre cluster, old meter spot): the LED's own 20 AWG pigtail, spliced right at the LED: sealed step-down solder splice, hand solder joint (14 AWG to 20 AWG) under adhesive-lined heat shrink ATUM-4/1-0-SP (Dan A3, 2026-11-12)
route_branch: glove-box LOGIC box along the dash run to the cluster branch, then the cluster run (the w_dev_clu run)
notes: Dan A2 b (2026-11-12; replaces the 220 ohm resistor R-HB and the wires w_hb_r_cp, w_hl_high and w_hb_a): one wire from the high-beam output splice straight to the high-beam LED + on the cluster LED board; the factory R-L lead at C13 (B) pin 12 no longer feeds the LED (removal rows w_rl_c13_cut, w_rl_ie1_cut, w_rl_c15_cut). Lit while K-HR is on (HIGH or FLASH with the head lamps on). Dash owns it (DECISIONS "Harness ownership (B8 list)": the LED board is Dash's); it rides Dash's glove-box run to the cluster with w_dev_clu (glove box, dash run, cluster branch, cluster tap). TXL 14: the wire sits on HR 15 A, so the fuse protects it (B12 step 4; same as the high-beam legs w_hr_on_cp, w_pmu_hr); Dan A3 (2026-11-12): no inline fuse for one LED; the wire ends on the LED's own 20 AWG pigtail with a sealed step-down solder splice right at the LED (B12 step-down; Dan 2026-10-30: any wire may be spliced onto any size pigtail, a crimped contact must fit its wire). No TE Raychem D-150 SolderSleeve takes both 14 and 20 AWG (TE drawing D-150-0228X-0239: 26-20, 20-16, 16-12, 14-12 ...), so a hand solder joint under adhesive-lined heat shrink ATUM-4/1-0-SP (on hand; 4.0 mm expanded / 1.0 mm recovered, -55 to 110 C, TE ATUM data sheet); tools: soldering iron and heat gun (no crimp). The LED takes mA only: a 12 V LED like the turn LEDs D-TL / D-TR (no series resistor).
wire_label: High beam LED + (from the high-beam relay)
